Isolated rat hearts (n=48) were perfused in the retrograde mode with modified Krebs-Henseleit buffer, and following the induction of 30 min global ischemia, ascorbate (150 μM) and/or catechin (5 μM) were added directly into the perfusate during 90 min reperfusion. The experiments showed that 150 μM ascorbate protected the heart against lipid peroxidation and cell apoptosis by 100%, while 5 μM catechin protected by 67% and 90% respectively. Due to the strong protection by ascorbate alone, no cooperative protective effect could be observed when ascorbate and catechin were used together. In conclusion, this preclinical study showed strong protection against myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury by ascorbate in the perfusate at a much lower concentration than most clinical trials, and protection by catechin at a physiological dose.

articles.title: Temporal Eating Patterns Show Inconsistent Associations With Cancer Incidence and Mortality: Systematic Review of Prospective Studies.
articles.authors: Sihan Song, Tuo Lan, Seho Park et al.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Temporal eating patterns, such as eating time, frequency, and regularity, may be associated with cancer outcomes through circadian and metabolic pathways, but evidence remains limited. OBJECTIVES: We aimed to systematically review prospective studies examining associations between temporal eating patterns and cancer incidence or mortality. METHODS: Following PRISMA guidelines, PubMed and Embase were searched from inception to September 2, 2026. Eligible studies included prospective cohorts of adults assessing eating or fasting duration, nighttime eating, breakfast frequency or timing, meal regularity, or eating frequency in relation to cancer incidence or mortality. Meta-analyses were conducted when ≥3 studies examined comparable exposure-outcome pairs, and the quality of meta-evidence was evaluated using the NutriGrade scoring system. Risk of bias was assessed using the Risk of Bias for Nutrition Observational Studies tool. RESULTS: Seventeen prospective cohort studies were included. Findings for eating or fasting duration and nighttime eating varied across studies for both cancer incidence and mortality. Lower breakfast frequency was associated with higher cancer mortality and colorectal cancer incidence in some studies, but not with breast cancer incidence. Greater eating-time variability and unrestrained eating were associated with higher cancer mortality, with unrestrained eating also associated with higher colorectal cancer incidence. Associations between eating frequency and cancer outcomes varied across studies and cancer sites. A meta-analysis of three studies showed a non-significant inverse association between eating frequency and colorectal cancer incidence in both categorical (HR = 0.81, 95% CI: 0.64-1.03) and dose-response analyses (HR per 1 time/day increase = 0.95, 95% CI: 0.89-1.01), with very low-quality meta-evidence. Risk of bias varied across domains, with common concerns related to confounding and exposure changes over follow-up. CONCLUSIONS: Findings from cohort studies suggest potential associations between temporal eating patterns and cancer outcomes, but the evidence remains limited and heterogeneous, underscoring the need for further investigation. PROSPERO REGISTRATION: CRD420251246423.

articles.title: New decompression gas CF₄/O₂: reducing DCS risk and ameliorating injuries in male rats.
articles.authors: Jiaqi Li, Hong Chen, Zhi Li et al.
articles.abstract: Decompression sickness (DCS) remains a major risk in diving. Prolonging decompression reduces inert gas load but increases operation time and underwater exposure. We tested a carbon tetrafluoride-oxygen mixture (CF₄/O₂) as a decompression gas in two rat decompression protocols: 6 ATA compressed air and 9 ATA helium-oxygen (heliox). Switching to CF₄/O₂ 10 min before decompression significantly reduced DCS incidence in both protocols: air, 68% (19/28) to 11% (3/28); heliox, 68% (15/22) to 18% (4/22). Mortality was significantly reduced in the compressed-air protocol (29% [8/28] to 0 [0/28], P = 0.004) but not in the heliox protocol (14% [3/22] to 0 [0/22], P = 0.233). Echocardiography showed fewer or no intracardiac bubbles after CF₄/O₂. In the heliox protocol, CF₄/O₂ significantly modulated some pulmonary function parameters; in the compressed-air protocol, pulmonary function changes were time-dependent and did not differ significantly between groups. CF₄/O₂ also reduced lung inflammation, endothelial injury, and histological damage in both protocols. In a 28-day repeated hyperbaric exposure protocol assessing selected serum biochemical endpoints, CF₄/O₂ did not increase serum alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase, creatinine or urea; however, this protocol did not include post-exposure histopathology or haematology, so safety conclusions are limited to the measured endpoints. These findings support the tested CF₄/O₂ gas-switching strategy under the specific conditions used. Shorter decompression protocols were not tested, and shortening decompression time remains a potential application rather than a demonstrated outcome.

articles.title: Is Large Language Model a New Hope for the Global South? A Rapid Bibliometric Synthesis of Artificial Intelligence in Anatomy Education.
articles.authors: Yue Lin, Yusi Huang, Junming Zhou et al.
articles.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), especially the recent proliferation of generative Large Language Models (LLMs), is transforming traditional anatomy education by introducing new teaching tools. However, the adoption of these cutting-edge technologies raises questions about global educational equity. It remains unclear whether AI will serve as a digital equalizer or further exacerbate marginalization. This rapid bibliometric synthesis aims to provide a comprehensive, data-driven overview of the "Application of Artificial Intelligence in Anatomy Education" (AAAE). We seek to map the intellectual landscape, detect structural and technological shifts, evaluate the geopolitical disparities, and provide corresponding references. A total of 85 consolidated records were retrieved from Web of Science and Scopus. These data constituted the whole panorama of AAAE. Bibliometrix and CiteSpace were utilized for static and dynamic mapping. A multidisciplinary expert panel validated the thematic clusters using Gwet's AC1 and the Normalized Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI). Publications surged following ChatGPT's release, indicating a shift from specialized computer vision to the application of general-purpose LLMs. While high-income countries maintain leadership, AI could exert a "democratizing effect" on upper-middle-income countries, doubling their odds of publication compared to traditional anatomy. Six research frontiers and three research trajectories were captured, and corresponding implications for future researchers in the global south and north were presented. AAAE could be conducted using a stratified strategy: different expansions of AI technologies for pedagogy; leveraging commercial APIs to bypass infrastructure bottlenecks; and validating open-source models. Global equity critically demands cross-border collaboration and inclusive datasets.

articles.title: Mechanisms of body rotation in the discus throw: contributions of ground reaction forces and the free moment to the angular momentum of the body-discus system in male throwers.
articles.authors: Keitaro Seki, Shota Kikuchi
articles.abstract: The angular momentum about the vertical axis is closely associated with release speed in the discus throw; however, kinetic studies remain almost nonexistent due to the methodological difficulties of measurement. The present study aimed to investigate the mechanisms underlying angular momentum generation about the vertical axis from the perspective of the ground reaction forces. Twelve elite or highly trained male right-handed discus throwers performed discus throw on force platforms while their motions were captured. The largest contributions to angular momentum were the moments of ground reaction forces (MGRF) of both feet during the first double support phase (DSP1). Furthermore, the MGRF of the right foot during DSP1 and the left foot during the first single support phase (SSP1) were correlated positively with the maximum angular momentum. The leftward shift of the system's center of mass during DSP1 effectively increased the moment arm, thereby enhancing the contribution of the MGRF to the angular momentum. During SSP1, although the contribution of the left foot MGRF was relatively smaller than that during DSP1, its correlation with the maximum angular momentum suggests that precise control of the right leg swing is crucial for minimizing the loss of angular momentum.

articles.title: Making sense of touch: Spatial tactile cues promote efficient visuo-somatosensory integration and restore motor accuracy under sensory conflict.
articles.authors: Maria Evangelia Vlachou, Eva Lafaverges, Laurence Mouchnino et al.
articles.abstract: Effective interaction with complex environments relies on the integration of somatosensory and visual signals into coherent spatial representations of the body in external space. When these signals conflict, as during goal-directed hand movements under mirror-reversed visual feedback, motor performance deteriorates. Despite this conflict, the visual mapping between the hand and the environment remains preserved, and visual information typically facilitates motor performance, whereas tactile feedback impairs it. Here, we tested whether providing tactile input with explicit spatial structure renders visuo-somatosensory integration functionally relevant and stabilizes motor behaviour under sensory conflict. Healthy adults performed a mirror-tracing task, tracing a shape's contour with the index finger while tactile feedback conveyed either motion-related cues alone or additional discrete spatial landmarks aligned with the outline. Spatially structured tactile cues preserved movement accuracy and smoothness relative to motion-related tactile input, indicating more effective online motor control. EEG source analyses further revealed that, when spatial tactile cues were present, somatosensory activity increased and functional connectivity was largely restricted to sensorimotor areas. In contrast, when tactile cues did not convey spatial information, sensory conflict was associated with widespread reductions in cortical activity, including in somatosensory and parietal areas, and with a diffuse functional connectivity pattern consistent with elevated sensorimotor uncertainty. Together, these findings indicate that providing spatial structure to tactile input can mitigate the detrimental effects of visuo-somatosensory conflict on motor performance and support more efficient integration of visual and somatosensory information during action. KEY POINTS: Accurate movements depend on combining visual and somatosensory information to estimate the position of the body in external space. When these signals conflict, motor performance usually deteriorates and tactile feedback can become disruptive. We tested whether tactile feedback becomes useful for movement control when it provides explicit spatial landmarks, rather than only motion-related information from finger-surface contact. During a tracing task under visuo-somatosensory conflict, spatially structured tactile cues preserved movement accuracy and smoothness compared with when touch conveyed motion cues alone. Spatial tactile cues were associated with increased somatosensory cortical activity and a more spatially restricted pattern of functional coupling within sensorimotor networks, whereas their absence was associated with reduced somatosensory and parietal activity and a more distributed connectivity profile. Spatial structure in touch promotes multisensory integration, helping stabilize motor control under sensory conflict and highlighting how tactile cue design may improve sensorimotor function.

articles.title: Simultaneous acquisition of maternal and dual-fetal electrocardiography with maternal haemodynamic monitoring in anaesthetized pregnant rats.
articles.authors: Sarah Pribil Pardun, Spencer Duff, Payton Ward et al.
articles.abstract: Experimental approaches that acquire maternal haemodynamics together with direct cardiac signals from more than one fetus remain limited. We developed a standardized in vivo method for simultaneous acquisition of maternal ECG, maternal arterial blood pressure and ECGs from two fetuses in anaesthetized late-gestation Sprague-Dawley rats. The platform combines custom-fabricated needle electrodes with conventional cardiovascular instrumentation and PowerLab/LabChart acquisition. Stable, analysable maternal arterial blood pressure, maternal ECG and dual-fetal ECG were maintained for ≤5 h. The recordings supported beat-to-beat ECG interval and heart rate variability analyses. Fetuses had lower heart rates and longer R-R intervals than dams, and fetal root mean square of successive differences (RMSSD), high-frequency power and standard deviation of RR intervals (SDRR) were lower than maternal values. As proof of recording responsiveness, maternal noradrenaline and verapamil administration produced readily resolved maternal haemodynamic changes together with time-aligned fetal heart rate responses. This protocol does not by itself demonstrate maternal-fetal cardiac coupling; rather, it provides synchronized high-resolution signals suitable for future analyses of dynamic maternal-fetal cardiovascular relationships and pharmacological responses.

articles.title: The Effects of Blueberry Consumption on Cerebral Blood Flow and Brain Glutathione Levels in Older Adults: A Double-Blind Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial.
articles.journal: The American journal of clinical nutrition
articles.authors: In-Young Choi, Caitlin Payne, Phil Lee et al.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Age-related declines in brain antioxidant capacity and cerebral blood flow (CBF) contribute to cognitive decline and increase the risk of Alzheimer's disease and dementias. Dietary approaches that enhance cerebral antioxidant defenses and CBF may promote brain health during aging. Blueberries are rich in polyphenols with antioxidant properties, and cardiometabolic and endothelial benefits, and may improve both brain glutathione (GSH), a major endogenous antioxidant, and CBF. However, the effects of blueberry intake on brain GSH and CBF have not been well established. OBJECTIVE: To determine the effects of blueberry consumption on brain GSH and CBF in brain regions vulnerable to aging and neurodegeneration in older adults. METHODS: In a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial, older adults aged 65-89 years with low berry intake (≤1 serving/week) consumed freeze-dried whole blueberry powder (hereafter "blueberry") equivalent to one cup of fresh blueberries or a matched placebo powder for three months. Brain GSH and regional CBF were measured using multiple quantum chemical shift imaging and pseudo-continuous arterial spin labeling MRI, respectively. RESULTS: Sixty participants completed the intervention with adherence exceeding 92% in both groups. Blueberry powder consumption did not alter brain GSH concentrations compared with placebo but significantly increased CBF in the anterior cingulate cortex (P=0.03), a region involved in executive function and cognitive control. Within-group analyses showed increased CBF after blueberry consumption in the anterior cingulate cortex (7%, P=0.03; 95% confidence interval: 1.0%, 14.7%), caudate (7%, P=0.01; 2.9%, 15.8%), and putamen (6%, P=0.04; 0.3%, 13.9%), whereas no significant changes were observed in the placebo group. CONCLUSIONS: Compared with placebo, blueberry consumption increased CBF in the anterior cingulate cortex, a brain region relevant to age-related cognitive decline. No corresponding brain GSH changes were observed, suggesting that the effects of blueberry polyphenols are more consistent with vascular modulation than alterations in cerebral antioxidant status. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRY NUMBER: NCT05024916 CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRY URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05024916.

articles.title: Virtual cranial endocast of Lotheridium mengi and brain evolution in early metatherians.
articles.authors: Alexander Bi, Byron D Ford, Qian Li et al.
articles.abstract: Very little is known about the early brain evolution of Metatheria, and no brain endocast of this group has been described from prior to the Cretaceous-Paleogene (K-Pg) boundary. This has led to great uncertainty regarding the ancestral condition of the therian brain. Here, we aim to fill some of this gap by describing the first brain endocast of a Cretaceous metatherian, Lotheridium mengi from the Late Cretaceous of Henan, China. Lotheridium has an encephalization quotient comparable to the Cretaceous multituberculate Chulsanbaatar and eutherian Asioryctes and reaches the lower range of crown mammals. Together with patterns observed in other Mesozoic mammals, this suggests that increased encephalization evolved independently in several major mammalian lineages. The endocast is characterized by relatively small olfactory bulbs, well-developed petrosal lobules, and a prominent hypophyseal cast, differentiating it from earlier mammals. With the addition of a dorsally exposed midbrain, Lotheridium closely resembles the condition observed in Cretaceous eutherians. We propose that reduced olfactory bulb proportions and increased endocranial volume in Cretaceous eutherians and metatherians reflect a major shift in mammalian brain evolution, from primarily olfactory bulb expansion in the Jurassic to predominantly neocortical, brainstem, and cerebellar expansion in the Late Cretaceous. The endocranial morphology of Lotheridium further indicates that several neuroanatomical features characteristic of Paleogene and extant marsupials, including relatively enlarged olfactory bulbs and a smaller brain size compared to eutherians, are unlikely to represent the plesiomorphic condition for Metatheria. Ultimately, Lotheridium provides crucial new information regarding the ancestral condition of marsupial brains.

articles.title: A multimodal deep learning model for classifying early- versus late-stage osteonecrosis of the femoral head on biparametric MRI.
articles.authors: Siyuan Li, Huimin Huang, Yetong He et al.
articles.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Precise early- versus late-stage stratification of osteonecrosis of the femoral head (ONFH) is critical for hip-preserving treatment selection, yet conventional MRI interpretation suffers from interobserver variability and limited objectivity. This study aimed to develop a multimodal deep learning model integrating biparametric MRI (STIR and T1-FSE) with clinical parameters (including age, sex, affected side (left, right, or bilateral), and etiology) to differentiate early- from late-stage ONFH and provide objective imaging evidence. METHODS: This retrospective study included 530 patients with ONFH, yielding imaging data from 851 hips. The collected data comprised STIR sequences, T1-FSE sequences, and clinical information, including age, sex, and etiology. The dataset was randomly divided at the patient level into a training set (424 patients, 675 hips) and a test set (106 patients, 176 hips) at an 8:2 ratio. Seven models were constructed: a clinical model, a STIR model, a T1-FSE model, a bpMRI model, a STIR-clinical model, a T1-FSE-clinical model, and a bpMRI-clinical model. Early- and late-fusion strategies were used for multimodal integration. The diagnostic performance of the seven models for classifying early- versus late-stage ONFH was systematically compared, with particular emphasis on their ability to identify borderline cases at the transition between clinical stages. Model interpretability was assessed using Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM). RESULTS: The early-fusion bpMRI-clinical model achieved the highest AUC of 0.944 (95% CI 0.905-0.973), accuracy 90.9%, sensitivity 89.0%, and specificity 92.9%, significantly outperforming single-sequence models (all P < 0.05). The confusion matrix showed that the model misclassified 10 late-stage cases as early-stage and 6 early-stage cases as late-stage. Grad-CAM visualizations indicated that the model primarily focused on clinically relevant regions, including the necrotic lesion boundary, areas of bone marrow edema, and subchondral structural abnormalities. These attention patterns were highly consistent with the core imaging features used for early- versus late-stage ONFH stratification. CONCLUSION: This study presents an interpretable multimodal deep learning framework that integrates dual-sequence MRI with clinical parameters. The framework accurately differentiates early- from late-stage ONFH according to the ARCO classification and provides objective evidence for determining the critical threshold for hip-preservation decision-making. TRIAL REGISTRATION: The trial was registered with the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (Registration No: ChiCTR2300075354. Sep 1, 2023).

articles.title: Axial Complex of Deep-Sea Acorn Worm Quatuoralisia malakhovi (Hemichordata, Enteropneusta, Torquaratoridae).
articles.authors: Olga V Ezhova, Anastasiya I Lukinykh, Vladimir V Malakhov
articles.abstract: The axial complex (proboscis complex or heart-kidney) is well-studied for the shallow-living enteropneusts that burrow into the sediment and use the muscular proboscis as the primary locomotor organ. However, the deep-sea enteropneusts in the family Torquaratoridae are epibenthic surface-dwellers with a dispersed, poorly developed proboscis musculature. There is little data on the structure of their axial complex (AC). We have studied in detail the microscopic anatomy of the AC of three specimens of torquaratorid Quatuoralisia malakhovi Ezhova et Lukinykh, 2022. The proboscis of Q. malakhovi is widely fused with the collar along the entire dorsal side rather than being connected by a narrow stalk. The AC includes the buccal diverticulum (stomochord), pericardium, glomerulus (axial organ) and associated blood vessels, perihaemal coeloms, and proboscis skeletal elements. The latter are two separate symmetrical plates supporting the buccal diverticulum laterally. The buccal diverticulum is elongated in transverse direction and packed with large, vacuolated cells without a lumen. It is completely separated from the main course of the gut. The pericardium lies on the dorsal side of the buccal diverticulum. The heart is absent. The glomerulus consists of two symmetrical extensions separated by the confluence of the dorsal blood vessel. The latter is accompanied by the perihaemal coeloms and splits into several branches resembling the mouth of a river, which then flow into the glomerulus. Two buccal blood vessels with folded walls run from the sides of the glomerulus to the ventral blood vessel. A protocoelomic coelomopore is absent, however we found a pair of mesocoelomic coelomoducts and coelomopores. The torquaratorid AC demonstrates varying degrees of reduction. None of the previously studied species of Torquaratoridae possesses a complete set of AC components characteristic of shallow-living enteropneusts. Torquaratoridae are derived in terms of structure and composition of the AC compared to non-torquaratorid hemichordates.

articles.title: Biological Insights From the Osteohistology of a Nile Crocodile.
articles.authors: Ayanda Buso, Maria Eugenia Pereyra, Anusuya Chinsamy
articles.abstract: While long bones are mostly utlised for skeletochronology of extant and extinct vertebrates, among crocodilians, dermal bones have also been studied. However, there is a lack of a systematic and comprehensive study of the variation in osteohistology and skeletochronology of limb, axial, and dermal bones of extant crocodilians. Here, we undertake a comprehensive assessment of the histology of multiple postcranial elements of a single, captive adult Crocodylus niloticus (with approximately known age) to assess their utility for skeletochronology. We document the intraskeletal histological variability in the skeleton and show that despite the gastralia recording the highest number of growth rings, the radius, ulna, and fibula are more reliable for skeletochronology. We show substantial variation in the histology of the osteoderms depending on the plane of sectioning, as well as their location on the body of the crocodile. Additionally, we report that anteriorly sectioned dorsal osteoderms preserved the highest number of growth marks. Our study provides important information regarding intraskeletal variation in osteohistology and presents key information regarding the choice of skeletal elements for reliable life history reconstruction of C. niloticus.

articles.title: The Evolutionary History of Early Ray-Finned Fishes (Pan-Actinopterygii).
articles.authors: Jack Stack
articles.abstract: One out of every two vertebrate species is a ray-finned fish (Actinopterygii). The ~380-million-year fossil record of ray-finned fishes provides a window into the evolutionary history of actinopterygian diversity in deep time. The actinopterygian fossil record shows that the ray-finned fish crown group (Actinopterygii) lived alongside speciose members of now extinct lineages, collectively referred to as early actinopterygians. I review the evolutionary history of early actinopterygians through deep time, including morphology, taxonomy, phylogeny, and the fossil record itself, to form a foundation for future research. Early actinopterygians are a paraphyletic assemblage of ~600 extinct species divided between ~22 named clades and the "palaeoniscoids," a taxonomic wastebasket comprised of hundreds of species. Although nearly a decade of phylogenetic research indicates that most early actinopterygians branch off the ray-finned fish stem group, their interrelationships are largely unresolved. Notable gaps in the record of early actinopterygians, which ranges from the Early Devonian to the Early Cretaceous, include a nearly non-existent Early Devonian record, an almost complete lack of Pennsylvanian-Middle Permian marine assemblages, a gap in the Middle Triassic record obscuring the start of a decline in early actinopterygian diversity, and a sparsely documented Jurassic record. We are poised to build a reliable systematic framework for early actinopterygians via novel methods for phylogenetic analysis, fossil imaging, and the increased connectivity of paleoichthyologyists around the globe. The promise of a reliable systematic framework for early actinopterygians is to better describe the entire history of Actinopterygii and actinopterygian macroevolution in deep time.

articles.title: WM-S25: Validation of heated-hand venous arterialization at sea level and high altitude.
articles.authors: Jessica N Kenney, Ibrahim A Wafai, Brooke R Shepley et al.
articles.abstract: Arterial blood sampling remains the gold standard for blood gas and acid-base analysis; however, it can be logistically challenging in research settings, especially during field research. In this study, we evaluated the validity of arterializing venous blood in the hand through 25 min of warm (45°C) water hand immersion, in comparison to direct arterial (brachial) sampling in healthy adults (age range 20-35 years, mean 24 years) at both sea level (334 m a.s.l., n = 15) and high altitude (3800 m a.s.l., n = 11). Agreement was assessed using Bland-Altman analyses. For the primary analysis of P O 2 , equivalence testing was also performed with a predefined margin of ±5 mmHg. Secondary analyses included P C O 2 , oxygen saturation, glucose, lactate, pH and HCO3 -. At sea level, hand heating reduced the mean bias for arterial-venous P O 2 from -20.85 mmHg [unheated 95% limits of agreement (LOA): -38.72 to -2.97 mmHg] to -7.99 mmHg (heated 95% LOA: -26.68 to 10.71 mmHg). At high altitude, hand heating reduced the mean bias for arterial-venous P O 2 from -5.99 mmHg (unheated 95% LOA: -11.82 to -0.16 mmHg) to -0.98 mmHg (heated 95% LOA: -3.60 to 1.63 mmHg). Equivalence testing demonstrated that heated venous P O 2 was equivalent to arterial P O 2 only at high altitude, with no equivalence observed in any other conditions. Agreement for P C O 2 , pH, HCO3 -, glucose and lactate was generally good irrespective of hand heating or elevation, whereas heating improved agreement for oxygen saturation at both elevations. These findings support heated-hand venous arterialization as a practical alternative to arterial sampling for assessment of arterial P O 2 during high-altitude research.

articles.title: Dissociated orientation biases of local gamma oscillations and cross-laminar delta-gamma coupling in mouse primary visual cortex.
articles.authors: Baitao Liao, Kehan Chen, Zhengjiang Yang et al.
articles.abstract: Gamma-band neural oscillations are implicated in sensory feature processing, yet their laminar organization and cross-frequency coupling in the mouse primary visual cortex (V1) remain poorly defined. Using linear electrode arrays, we recorded local field potentials and multi-unit activity across cortical layers in lightly anaesthetized adult male C57BL/6 mice during presentation of drifting grating stimuli. We systematically characterize orientation selectivity and phase-amplitude coupling (PAC). Visual stimulation most strongly drove cross-laminar PAC involving L6 delta phase (1-3 Hz) and L4 gamma amplitude (25-75 Hz) (hereafter L6-L4 PAC, where the first layer denotes the source of low-frequency phase and the second layer the source of high-frequency amplitude), with significantly greater coupling strength for L6-L4 PAC than for the reciprocal L4-L6 PAC. Notably, local gamma power exhibited a robust, consistent vertical preference, whereas L6-L4 PAC showed a significant horizontal bias. Dataset-level analyses revealed that the vertical preference of gamma originated from consistent clustering of peak directions around vertical, whereas the horizontal bias of PAC emerged from the accumulation of weak, widely distributed individual deviations. These findings reveal a functional dissociation between local gamma oscillations and cross-laminar PAC in mouse V1: gamma power shows a vertical bias that may carry orientation information, whereas L6-L4 delta-gamma coupling shows a weaker horizontal bias and may reflect a form of cross-laminar temporal co-ordination. KEY POINTS: Visual stimulation drives robust cross-laminar phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) from layer 6 delta-phase (1-3 Hz) to layer 4 gamma-amplitude (25-75 Hz), with significantly stronger coupling than the reverse direction (L4 → L6). Local gamma power (25-75 Hz) exhibits a consistent, depth-invariant preference for vertical orientations across all cortical layers. In contrast, L6 → L4 PAC shows a significant horizontal bias, revealing a functional dissociation between local gamma oscillations and inter-laminar coupling. Single-trial analyses show that gamma's vertical preference arises from tight clustering of peak directions, whereas PAC's horizontal bias emerges from weak, scattered individual deviations summing to a population effect. These findings suggest that local gamma power encodes feature-specific orientation information, while L6 → L4 δ-γ coupling provides a stimulus-engaged, horizontally biased rhythmic scaffold for inter-laminar coordination.

articles.title: Intercellular crosstalk and functional heterogeneity of hepatic stellate cells: A translational framework for chronic liver disease.
articles.authors: Olga Martínez-Arroyo, Mireia Sastre-Navarro, Juan V Esplugues et al.
articles.abstract: Chronic liver diseases are a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, with hepatic fibrosis representing the common pathological pathway that can lead to cirrhosis, portal hypertension and hepatocellular carcinoma. Hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) are the principal source of myofibroblasts during liver fibrogenesis and have therefore emerged as central therapeutic targets. However, recent advances in single-cell transcriptomics, spatial omics and lineage-tracing approaches have fundamentally revised the traditional view of HSC activation as a uniform process. Instead, HSCs comprise a spectrum of phenotypically and functionally distinct states that dynamically evolve in response to chronic liver injury and differ in their contributions to extracellular matrix deposition, inflammation, immune regulation, vascular remodelling and tissue repair. During disease progression, HSCs integrate biochemical, metabolic and biomechanical cues derived from injured hepatocytes, liver sinusoidal endothelial cells, immune cells and the extracellular matrix, while simultaneously reshaping the hepatic microenvironment through reciprocal intercellular communication mediated by soluble factors, extracellular vesicles, direct cell-cell interactions and matrix-derived signals. This bidirectional crosstalk underlies both fibrosis progression and its potential regression, highlighting HSC plasticity as a defining feature of chronic liver disease. In this review, we discuss the emerging concepts of HSC phenotypic heterogeneity and intercellular communication, summarizing the molecular mechanisms that govern HSC state transitions and their interactions within the hepatic niche. Finally, we examine how these discoveries are transforming current approaches to precision anti-fibrotic therapies, providing a translational framework for the treatment of chronic liver diseases.

articles.title: Sphenoid sinus volume according to multidimensional pneumatization patterns: a cone-beam computed tomography study.
articles.authors: Matheus Kawana Couto, Maria Luiza Sastre Catija, Lilian Cristina Vessoni Iwaki et al.
articles.abstract: PURPOSE: To characterize differences in total sphenoid sinus volume according to multidimensional pneumatization patterns and demographic characteristics using cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT). METHODS: A total of 200 CBCT scans from 200 individuals (100 females and 100 males; mean age: 37.15 ± 14.60 years) were retrospectively analyzed. Total sphenoid sinus volume was obtained by three-dimensional segmentation. Evaluated variables included sex, age, facial skeletal pattern, sellar-related, clival and lateral pneumatization, sphenoid sinus dominance, and intrasphenoidal septations. Group comparisons used non-parametric tests, and multiple linear regression was used to quantify adjusted volumetric differences across demographic and anatomical categories. RESULTS: Total sphenoid sinus volume differed by sex, age group, and sellar-related, clival, and lateral pneumatization patterns (all p < 0.05), but not by facial skeletal pattern, sphenoid sinus dominance, or number of intrasphenoidal septations. In the adjusted model, female sex was associated with lower volume, whereas incomplete sellar and complete sellar pneumatization, combined dorsal-occipital clival extension, and full lateral extension were associated with greater volume (adjusted R² = 0.586; p < 0.001). Sensitivity analyses supported the associations with sellar-related and lateral pneumatization, whereas the clival association varied according to the analytical approach. CONCLUSION: Sphenoid sinus volume varied according to sex and multidimensional pneumatization patterns. Sellar-related and lateral patterns showed consistent volumetric differences across analytical approaches, whereas findings for clival pneumatization were more sensitive to the analytical strategy and should be interpreted with greater caution.

articles.title: Ultrasound mapping of the radial nerve along the lateral humerus in children: safe and danger zones.
articles.authors: Gündüz Ercan Kutluay, Mehmet Ümit Çetin, Abdülkadir Sarı et al.
articles.abstract: PURPOSE: Absolute distances from bony landmarks locate the radial nerve in adults but change with growth. Using ultrasound, we mapped it along the lateral humerus in children, expressing its position as a proportion of the humeral segment. METHODS: In 102 children aged 3-13 years without upper-extremity pathology, four points were prospectively marked with ultrasound on the right arm: the lateral epicondyle (P1), the points where the nerve leaves (P2) and reaches (P3) the lateral cortex, and the greater tubercle (P4). The distal safe zone (P1-P2), danger zone (P2-P3) and proximal safe zone (P3-P4) were tape-measured and expressed as proportions of the segment (P1-P4). RESULTS: P3 lay at 51.2 ± 5.4% of the segment from the greater tubercle, not significantly associated with age (p = 0.326). From 3​​-5 to 12-13 years, the distal safe zone increased from 24.5% to 29.7% of the segment (p < 0.001) and the danger zone decreased from 23.9% to 20.5% (p = 0.009). In no child did the nerve's lateral course reach the distal ninth or proximal third, with margins exceeding measurement error; yet age and segment length predicted P3 only within ± 23 mm, a window as long as the danger zone. Intra- and interobserver intraclass correlation coefficients were ≥ 0.925. CONCLUSION: Absolute distances increased with growth, whereas the nerve's proportional position showed no significant age-related change. The distal ninth and proximal third, free of its lateral course in every child, are preliminary anatomical estimates requiring validation. Between them, direct visualisation or ultrasound identification of the nerve appears necessary.

articles.title: The inspired-expired temperature gradient: a candidate bedside readout of airway gas-conditioning stress during invasive ventilation.
articles.authors: Shailesh Bihari, Ubbo F Wiersema
articles.abstract: Ventilator-induced lung injury (VILI) is framed almost entirely in mechanical terms - tidal stress, strain and mechanical power - while the thermal conditioning of inspired gas is treated as a humidification housekeeping problem rather than a determinant of injury. Yet tracheal intubation abolishes most of the upper airway's heat- and water-exchanging capacity, and both inadequate and excessive gas conditioning provoke epithelial damage and airway inflammation in controlled animal ventilation. We propose that the breath-by-breath difference between expired and inspired gas temperature at the airway opening (ΔT = Tₑ - Tᵢ) is a physically simple, continuously available signal reflecting the heat the airway exchanges with each breath, and that the magnitude and trajectory of ΔT carry information about gas-conditioning adequacy and, plausibly, airway and lung injury during invasive ventilation. The same temperature difference has already been measured at the bedside in mechanically ventilated patients, but generally interpreted as a property of the humidification device or of ventilation-perfusion mismatch, rather than as a signal from the injured lung itself. Because expired gas temperature is also influenced by pulmonary blood flow and core temperature, these effects must be separated before any injury-related interpretation can be made. We outline the physiological rationale, existing measurement precedents, falsifiable predictions, and a staged approach to testing this hypothesis.

articles.title: Long-term recreational soccer participation and 10-year changes in cardiac structure and function in middle-aged women with hypertension.
articles.authors: Jacobina Kristiansen, Magni Mohr, Magna E Mørkøre et al.
articles.abstract: Cardiovascular risk increases across middle age in women, but the association between sustained recreational soccer participation and long-term cardiac remodelling is unclear. We investigated 10-year changes in echocardiographic measures of cardiac structure and function in middle-aged women with mild-to-moderate hypertension originally randomized to recreational soccer or non-exercise control. The exercise group continued organized recreational soccer participation, completing 1.6 (SD 0.6) sessions/week across the 10-year follow-up. At 10 years, 11 exercisers and 10 controls completed transthoracic echocardiography. Outcomes were analysed using constrained linear mixed-effects models. Left ventricular mass decreased in controls (-12.28 g; 95% CI -23.94 to -0.63; P = 0.0398) but did not change detectably in exercisers (7.39 g; 95% CI -3.81 to 18.59; P = 0.183), yielding a between-group difference in change of 19.67 g (95% CI 4.09 to 35.26; P = 0.0161). The corresponding indexed difference was 11.55 g/m2 (95% CI 2.52 to 20.58; P = 0.0151). Right ventricular internal diameter increased less in exercisers than controls (between-group difference, -0.56 cm; 95% CI -0.87 to -0.25; P = 0.00150). Confidence intervals for diastolic function, tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion and left atrial size spanned zero. Long-term recreational soccer participation was associated with differences in selected 10-year cardiac structural changes, but these small exploratory analyses do not establish beneficial remodelling.

articles.title: Cruciferous vegetable intake and dementia risk in community-dwelling Japanese people aged 40-74 years: a 13-year cohort study.
articles.authors: Madoka Nishigawa, Yumi Watanabe, Kaori Kitamura et al.
articles.abstract: Cruciferous vegetables containing isothiocyanates and indoles have been suggested to be associated with a reduced risk of dementia, but supporting evidence is scarce. The present cohort study aimed to determine whether cruciferous vegetable intake is associated with dementia risk in middle-aged and older adults. Participants were 13 203 Japanese people aged 40-74 years. Data were collected using a self-administered questionnaire. The predictor was cruciferous vegetable intake, and the outcome was newly diagnosed dementia using the Long-Term Care Insurance database. Covariates included age, sex, marital status, education level, occupation, BMI, total physical activity, smoking, alcohol consumption, coffee/green tea consumption, energy-adjusted non-cruciferous vegetable, fruit, dairy products, and fish intake and disease history. Information on food intake was obtained with a validated FFQ, with adjustments made for energy using the residual method. Hazard ratios (HR) were calculated using a Cox proportional hazards model. The mean age of participants was 59·1 years (sd 9·3). During a mean follow-up of 13·3 years, 1048 cases of dementia were observed. Lower cruciferous vegetable intake was associated with a higher dementia risk (P for trend = 0·0127), with an increased risk in the lowest intake quartile (HR = 1·28, 95 % CI: 1·04-1·59) than in the highest quartile (reference) after adjustment for covariates, including non-cruciferous vegetable intake. This association tended to be stronger in the younger subgroup of <65 years (HR = 1·91, 95 % CI: 1·24-2·94) than in the older subgroup of ≥65 years (P for interaction = 0·0856). In conclusion, lower cruciferous vegetable intake is associated with an increased risk of dementia in middle-aged and older people.

articles.title: Validity of a Consumer-Grade Bioelectrical Impedance Device for Body Composition Assessment Compared with a Three-Compartment Model in Recreationally Active Adults.
articles.journal: Applied physiology, nutrition, and metabolism = Physiologie appliquee, nutrition et metabolisme
articles.authors: Patrick G Saracino, Hannah K Eberhardt, Cecilia D Salas et al.
articles.abstract: This study aimed to validate a consumer multi-frequency bioelectrical impedance device against a 3-compartment (3C) model in recreationally active adults. Following an overnight fast and abstention from caffeine (12 h), alcohol (24 h), and strenuous exercise (24 h), participants underwent body composition assessment using a consumer multi-frequency bioelectrical impedance device (BIAH30; InBody Dial H30). A criterion 3C model was derived from body mass, body volume via air displacement plethysmography, and total body water via a validated multi-frequency bioelectrical impedance device. Fifty-five recreationally active participants (29M/26F; 22±4 years, 170.5±8.2 cm; 70.6±10.5 kg; 24.2±2.6 kg·m⁻²) completed the study. BF% (21.7±7.8% vs 19.9±7.8%) and FM (15.3±5.8 vs 14.0±5.8 kg) were higher with BIAH30 compared to 3C (p < 0.001), whereas FFM (55.5±10.6 vs 56.7±10.4 kg) was lower (p < 0.001). Bland-Altman analysis indicated mean biases of 1.9% (95% LOA: -4.0 to 7.7%), 1.3 kg (95% LOA: -2.7 to 5.3 kg), and -1.2 kg (95% LOA: -5.1 to 2.8 kg) for BF%, FM, and FFM, respectively, with no proportional bias. Lin's concordance correlation coefficient indicated moderate to strong agreement (CCC: 0.90-0.98). In conclusion, the InBody H30 demonstrated significant differences in BF%, FM, and FFM relative to 3C. Mean bias was small, no proportional bias was observed, and agreement was moderate to strong. However, 95% limits of agreement were wide, indicating notable individual variability. While the H30 may serve as a practical, low-cost option for group-level estimates or longitudinal tracking, it should not be considered interchangeable with multi-compartment models for precise individual-level measurement.

articles.title: Risk factors and efficacy comparison of different treatment methods for cervical spondylotic myelopathy complicated with traumatic central cord syndrome.
articles.authors: Shaosong Sun, Xingchen Zhang, Youlai Yu et al.
articles.abstract: OBJECTIVE: We aimed to analyze the independent risk factors for cervical spondylotic myelopathy (CSM) patients with traumatic central cord syndrome (TCCS). In addition, the short-term and medium-term efficacy of conservative treatment and surgical treatment on patients' neurological function and imaging were compared. METHODS: Total of 182 patients with CSM admitted in our hospital during January 2016 to December 2021 were chosen as the study subjects. They were divided into a complicated group (with TCCS) and a non-complicated group (without TCCS). Influencing factors were analyzed using univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses. A nomogram prediction model was constructed based on these factors. Patients with TCCS were divided into a conservative group (n = 30) and a surgical group (n = 38) according to the actual treatment received. Changes in the American Spinal Injury Association (ASIA) score, Spinal Cord Independence Measure III (SCIM-III) score, modified Japanese Orthopaedic Association (mJOA) score, and imaging parameters were compared between the two groups before treatment and at 3 and 6 months after treatment. Subgroup analyses were also performed according to ASIA grade, surgical timing, and surgical approach. Complications and the minimal clinically important difference (MCID) were assessed. RESULTS: Age, positive pathological signs, hand intrinsic muscle score, intramedullary high signal (IMHS) length, degree of spinal cord compression, and degree of spinal canal stenosis were all associated with CSM complicated by TCCS (P < 0.05). Multivariate Logistic regression analysis showed that advanced age (OR = 2.264), high IMHS length (OR = 2.532), high degree of spinal cord compression (OR = 3.438), and high degree of spinal canal stenosis (OR = 3.900) were independent risk factors for CSM complicated by TCCS. And high hand intrinsic muscle score (OR = 0.430) was an independent protective factor (all P < 0.05). A nomogram prediction model was constructed based on the above five factors. At 3 months after treatment, the improvements in ASIA sensory and motor scores, SCIM-III score, mJOA score, intervertebral space height, and cervical lordosis angle in the surgical group were significantly greater than those in the conservative group (all P < 0.05), and the differences reached the MCID threshold. At 6 months after treatment, no significant differences were observed in any indicators between the two groups (all P > 0.05). Subgroup analysis by ASIA grade showed that in the B/C grade subgroup, the improvement in ASIA motor score at 3 months was greater in the surgical group than in the conservative group (P = 0.038). No significant differences in neurological improvement were found between the surgical timing subgroups or between the surgical approach subgroups. There was no significant difference in the incidence of complications between the two groups (P > 0.05), and no severe complications were observed in either group. CONCLUSION: Advanced age, low hand intrinsic muscle score, high IMHS length, high degree of spinal cord compression, and high degree of spinal canal stenosis are independent risk factors for CSM complicated by TCCS. The nomogram provides a visual tool for clinical risk screening. Surgical treatment can significantly promote early (3-month) recovery of neurological function and imaging structure compared with conservative treatment, offering a distinct advantage in accelerating rehabilitation. However, the efficacy of the two treatment modalities converges at 6 months.

articles.title: Automated action potential parameter analysis for reproducible electrophysiological measurements in neurons.
articles.authors: Dmytro V Vasylyev, Stephen G Waxman
articles.abstract: Quantitative analysis of action potential (AP) waveforms is central to studies of neuronal excitability, ion channel function, disease mechanisms and pharmacological modulation. However, AP analysis is still often performed using partially manual workflows or proprietary software environments that can constrain the amount of information extracted from APs and limit reproducibility, transparency and throughput. Here, we present a freely available, open-source software tool for extracting AP parameters, developed for use with the OriginLab software package Origin/OriginPro. APpar detects APs from membrane voltage recordings using a user-defined derivative criterion and calculates a comprehensive set of excitability parameters, including resting membrane potential, voltage threshold, overshoot, afterhyperpolarization (AHP), AP amplitude, rise and decay time, AP duration, AP half-width, AP width at 0 mV, AP area above voltage threshold, dV/dtmax, dV/dtmin and interspike interval for the respective AP. Because AP threshold is a particularly sensitive and method-dependent measurement, APpar includes a TRUE-threshold validation algorithm. After the initial forward dV/dt threshold crossing is identified, the software finds AP overshoot, searches backward to the closest preceding local dV/dt maximum, then searches backward to the user-defined dV/dt crossing and recalculates AP parameters from this validated threshold point. We validated APpar using APs from dorsal root ganglion neuron current-clamp recordings, including copied identical APs, current-evoked repetitive firing and long-duration spontaneous firing. The software produced stable measurements from identical copied APs and extracted dynamic changes in AP parameters across repetitive and spontaneous firing sequences. APpar provides a transparent, customizable and Origin-compatible framework for reproducible AP analysis in neuronal electrophysiology. KEY POINTS: Action potential (AP) waveforms contain important information about neuronal excitability and function of the underlying ion channels, but their analysis is often performed using partially manual, labour-intensive workflows, constraining the amount of information extracted from each AP, which can limit reproducibility and throughput. Measurements such as AP threshold, amplitude and duration depend strongly on how threshold is defined, creating variability between studies and laboratories. We developed APpar, a freely available open-source software tool that automatically detects APs and extracts a comprehensive set of waveform and excitability parameters within the widely used Origin/OriginPro environment. APpar incorporates a novel TRUE-threshold (Temporally Reversed Unsupervised Extraction of the Threshold) validation algorithm that improves the consistency of derivative-based threshold detection while preserving user control over physiologically meaningful analysis settings. Validation using dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neuron recordings showed that APpar provides stable measurements and enables efficient analysis of single AP, repetitive and spontaneous firing, supporting reproducible studies of neuronal excitability and ion channel function.

meta.caveat: 筋膜链是描述连续性的模型，不是独立解剖结构或诊断标准；节点问题必须结合局部解剖、神经、关节、负荷与红旗判断。

lines.name: 浅背线
lines.tagline: 从足底到颅顶的后侧连续线
lines.overview: 浅背线把足底、跟骨、小腿三头、腘绳、骶结节韧带、竖脊肌和颅顶筋膜连成一条后侧力线，参与站立、行走、髋伸、躯干伸展与弹性储能。
functions: 站立与行走时维持后侧稳定
踝跖屈、膝屈、髋伸、躯干伸展的力传递
跑跳中的弹性储能与释放
principles: 连续性不等于因果：一条线紧，不等于另一端点一定痛。
负荷沿链条分配；某节点活动度/力量不足，邻近节点代偿。
先用局部负荷、神经、关节、红旗解释，再用链条补充。
lines.validation: 如果 SBL 参与，足底、小腿、腘绳、腰背在动作中应出现同向负荷反应；单点松解后症状可能短期变化，但不等于根治。反例：局部神经/关节问题可独立出现。

nodes.name: 足底筋膜/跟骨
nodes.anatomy: 足底筋膜从跟骨到趾骨，维持内侧纵弓；跟骨是 Achilles 与足底筋膜的交汇点。
nodes.role: 站立/行走时吸收与推进，参与绞盘机制。
issues: 晨起足跟痛、久坐后第一步痛
足弓负荷增加、跑步量突增
assessment: 晨起第一步痛、跟骨内侧压痛
solutions: 足内在肌（短足）、提踵、负荷管理
小腿/足底筋膜拉伸，鞋具短期辅助

nodes.name: 小腿三头/跟腱
nodes.anatomy: 腓肠肌起自股骨髁，比目鱼肌起自胫腓骨，汇成跟腱止于跟骨。
nodes.role: 踝跖屈、推进、吸收落地冲击。
issues: 跑量/跳跃突增后小腿紧张
solutions: 离心/等长提踵、渐进负荷
踝背屈活动度、跑量管理

nodes.name: 腘绳/坐骨结节
nodes.anatomy: 腘绳肌起自坐骨结节，跨髋膝双关节。
nodes.role: 髋伸、膝屈、跑步摆动期减速。
issues: 腘绳肌腱病、坐骨结节痛
髋铰链模式差、骨盆控制不足
assessment: 坐骨结节压痛、离心测试
solutions: 髋铰链、罗马尼亚硬拉、离心训练

nodes.name: 骶结节韧带/骶骨
nodes.anatomy: 骶结节韧带连接骶骨与坐骨结节，是 SBL 与骨盆稳定的重要节点。
nodes.role: 骨盆稳定、力从下肢传到躯干。
issues: 骶髂/臀部痛、单腿站不稳
assessment: 单腿站立、SIJ 集群（需专业）
solutions: 臀肌/核心训练、渐进负重
产后先做盆底/专业评估

nodes.name: 竖脊肌/胸腰筋膜
nodes.anatomy: 竖脊肌沿脊柱上行，胸腰筋膜连接背阔肌、臀肌、腹壁与竖脊肌。
nodes.role: 躯干伸展、抗屈曲、力传递。
issues: 久坐腰背疲劳、反复腰痛
髋/胸椎活动不足导致代偿
solutions: 髋铰链、死虫/鸟狗/侧平板
逐步硬拉/深蹲，疼痛教育

nodes.name: 颈后/颅顶筋膜
nodes.anatomy: 竖脊肌/枕下肌群与帽状腱膜在枕骨相连。
issues: 胸椎僵硬、屏幕时间过长
solutions: 胸椎活动、颈深屈肌、肩胛控制

sources: Myers TW. Anatomy Trains, 4th ed.（模型）
Neumann DA. Kinesiology of the Musculoskeletal System, 3rd ed.
JOSPT Clinical Practice Guidelines.

lines.name: 浅前线
lines.tagline: 从足背到颅顶的前侧连续线
lines.overview: 浅前线从足背、胫骨前肌、股四头/髌骨、腹直肌、胸骨到胸锁乳突肌和乳突，参与前侧稳定、髋膝伸展、躯干屈曲与呼吸。
principles: 前侧链过紧可能限制髋伸/胸廓扩展，但不等于原因。
呼吸模式与腹壁张力互相影响。
先看踝/膝/髋关节与负荷，再看链条。
lines.validation: 如果 SFL 参与，足背/胫前/股四头/腹直肌在蹬伸或呼吸时应有同向反应；单点拉伸不应被当作根治。反例：膝关节/髋关节局部问题可独立存在。

nodes.name: 足背/胫骨前肌
nodes.anatomy: 胫骨前肌起自胫骨外侧，止于内侧楔骨/第一跖骨，负责踝背屈。
solutions: 提踵、胫前训练、负荷管理

nodes.name: 股四头/髌骨
nodes.anatomy: 股四头经髌骨/髌腱止于胫骨结节；股直肌跨髋膝。
solutions: 股四头/臀肌力量、逐步屈膝

nodes.name: 腹直肌/胸骨
nodes.anatomy: 腹直肌从耻骨到胸骨/肋软骨，参与躯干屈曲与腹压。
solutions: 呼吸、核心稳定、渐进负荷

nodes.name: 胸锁乳突肌/乳突
nodes.anatomy: SCM 从胸骨/锁骨到乳突，参与颈屈/旋转与辅助呼吸。
solutions: 颈深屈肌、胸椎活动、呼吸训练

sources: Myers TW. Anatomy Trains, 4th ed.（模型）
Neumann DA. Kinesiology of the Musculoskeletal System, 3rd ed.
JOSPT Clinical Practice Guidelines.

lines.name: 侧线
lines.tagline: 从足外侧到颅侧的侧向稳定线
lines.overview: 侧线从腓骨肌、外踝、髂胫束、臀中肌/阔筋膜张肌、腹斜肌、肋间到胸锁乳突肌，参与侧向稳定、单腿控制与躯干侧屈。
functions: 单腿站立/步态的侧向稳定
principles: 侧线问题常与单腿控制/髋外展相关，但不等于局部组织短缩。
髂胫束是厚腱膜，不是可随意拉长的“筋”。
先看髋/踝/膝负荷，再评估链条。
lines.validation: 如果 LL 参与，单腿站立/侧向走/跑步时髋外侧、膝外侧、踝外侧可能出现同向负荷；暴力滚压/拉伸不应作为唯一方案。

nodes.name: 腓骨肌/外踝
nodes.anatomy: 腓骨长/短肌起自腓骨，绕外踝，控制足外翻/跖屈。
assessment: 外踝压痛、前抽屉（需专业）

nodes.name: 髂胫束/股骨外侧
nodes.anatomy: 髂胫束是阔筋膜张肌/臀肌筋膜的延续，止于胫骨 Gerdy 结节。
issues: 髂胫束综合征、膝外侧痛
solutions: 臀中肌、单腿控制、跑量管理

nodes.name: 臀中肌/TFL/髂嵴
nodes.anatomy: 臀中肌外展/稳定骨盆；TFL 参与髋屈/外展/内旋。
nodes.role: 单腿站立骨盆稳定、步态。

nodes.name: 腹斜肌/肋间
nodes.anatomy: 腹斜肌连接骨盆/胸廓，肋间肌连接肋骨。

nodes.name: 胸锁乳突肌/乳突
nodes.anatomy: SCM 连接胸骨/锁骨与乳突。

sources: Myers TW. Anatomy Trains, 4th ed.（模型）
JOSPT / BJSM iliotibial band reviews.
Neumann DA. Kinesiology of the Musculoskeletal System, 3rd ed.

lines.name: 螺旋线
lines.tagline: 环绕躯干的旋转控制线
lines.overview: 螺旋线从颈后/头颈经菱形肌、前锯肌、腹斜肌、腹直肌、内收肌、腘绳肌到骶结节韧带/竖脊肌，参与旋转控制、单腿与变向。
principles: 旋转控制需要髋/胸椎/核心协同，单点松解不够。
内收肌/腘绳/腹斜肌常与变向/单腿负荷相关。
链条模型不能替代局部评估。
lines.validation: 如果 SL 参与，单腿/变向/旋转动作中肩胛内侧、腹斜肌、内收肌、腘绳可能出现同向负荷；反例：局部关节/神经问题可独立存在。

nodes.name: 头颈（夹肌）
nodes.anatomy: 夹肌/头颈旋转肌群连接颈椎与胸椎。

nodes.name: 菱形肌/肩胛内侧
nodes.anatomy: 菱形肌连接胸椎棘突与肩胛内侧缘。
issues: 前锯肌/下斜方控制不足
solutions: 前锯肌/下斜方、胸椎活动

nodes.name: 前锯肌/胸廓
nodes.anatomy: 前锯肌起自肋骨，止于肩胛内侧缘，参与肩胛前伸/上回旋。
assessment: 长胸神经筛查（翼状/无力）
solutions: 前锯肌、肩胛俯卧撑、胸椎活动

nodes.name: 腹斜肌/腹直肌
nodes.anatomy: 腹外/内斜肌与腹直肌连接胸廓/骨盆。

nodes.name: 内收肌/耻骨
nodes.anatomy: 内收肌群起自耻骨/坐骨，止于股骨/胫骨。

nodes.name: 腘绳/骶结节
nodes.anatomy: 腘绳肌与骶结节韧带相连。

sources: Myers TW. Anatomy Trains, 4th ed.（模型）
Brukner & Khan. Clinical Sports Medicine, 5th ed.
JOSPT Clinical Practice Guidelines.

lines.name: 深前线
lines.tagline: 从舌/颈深到盆底/足底的深层支撑线
lines.overview: 深前线从舌、颈深、胸腔/纵隔、腰大肌、盆底、内收肌到胫骨后肌/足底，参与呼吸、核心稳定、髋屈与足弓支撑。
principles: 深前线与呼吸、盆底、髋屈关系密切，但不能把腰痛都归因于腰大肌。
盆底问题需要专业评估，Kegel 不是人人适合。
先看呼吸/负荷/红旗，再谈链条。
lines.validation: 如果 DFL 参与，呼吸、髋屈、盆底/足弓动作中可能出现同向反应；反例：局部关节/神经/内脏问题可独立存在。

nodes.name: 舌/颈深
nodes.anatomy: 舌骨/颈深肌群连接下颌、颅底与胸廓。
issues: 口呼吸/舌位异常、颈深紧张
solutions: 鼻呼吸/舌位训练（专业指导）

nodes.name: 胸腔/纵隔
nodes.anatomy: 纵隔/胸膜/心包与膈肌相连。

nodes.name: 腰大肌
nodes.anatomy: 腰大肌起自腰椎，止于股骨小转子；与髂肌合成髂腰肌。
issues: 腰痛（多因素，不要单归因）
solutions: 髋屈肌拉伸（温和）、臀肌/核心

nodes.name: 盆底
nodes.anatomy: 盆底肌封闭骨盆出口，与膈肌/腹横肌协同。
assessment: 盆底 PT 评估（专业）
solutions: 盆底 PT、呼吸、渐进负荷

nodes.name: 内收肌
nodes.anatomy: 内收肌群连接耻骨/坐骨与股骨。

nodes.name: 胫骨后肌/足底
nodes.anatomy: 胫骨后肌绕内踝止于足舟骨/跗骨，支撑内侧纵弓。
solutions: 提踵、短足、足弓支撑短期

sources: Myers TW. Anatomy Trains, 4th ed.（模型）
Bø K, et al. Pelvic floor muscle training.
Neumann DA. Kinesiology of the Musculoskeletal System, 3rd ed.

lines.name: 臂线
lines.tagline: 胸/背到手臂的四条连续线
lines.overview: 臂线分为浅前、浅后、深前、深后四条：胸/背→肩→臂→前臂，参与推、拉、过顶与手部精细控制。
functions: 肩胛/肩袖与手臂力传递
principles: 臂线问题常与肩胛/胸椎/肩袖控制相关，不是单纯“手臂紧”。
过顶/推拉负荷要逐步增加。
神经症状（麻木/无力）优先排查颈椎/周围神经。
lines.validation: 如果臂线参与，推/拉/过顶时胸/肩/臂应出现同向负荷；反例：颈椎神经根/肩袖撕裂可独立出现。

nodes.name: 浅前线：胸大肌→三角肌→肱二头→前臂屈肌
nodes.anatomy: 胸大肌止于肱骨，三角肌包绕肩，肱二头屈肘/旋后，前臂屈肌起自内上髁。
issues: 肩前/胸小肌紧张、肱二头肌腱病
solutions: 胸椎活动、肩胛控制、肩袖

nodes.name: 浅后线：斜方肌/背阔肌→三角肌→肱三头→前臂伸肌
nodes.anatomy: 斜方肌/背阔肌连接躯干与肩，肱三头伸肘，前臂伸肌起自外上髁。
issues: 肩胛内侧/背阔肌紧张、网球肘
solutions: 肩胛/肩袖、前臂伸肌离心

nodes.name: 深前线：胸小肌/锁骨→肱二头→前臂
nodes.anatomy: 胸小肌连接肋骨与喙突，肱二头长头穿过肩前。
issues: 圆肩、肩前痛、胸廓出口症状
assessment: 胸小肌长度、肩胛上回旋
solutions: 胸椎/肩胛、胸小肌温和拉伸

nodes.name: 深后线：菱形肌/肩胛提肌→肩袖→前臂
nodes.anatomy: 菱形肌/肩胛提肌连接颈椎/胸椎与肩胛，肩袖稳定盂肱。
nodes.role: 肩胛后缩/下回旋、肩袖稳定。
assessment: 肩胛内侧压痛、外旋力量

sources: Myers TW. Anatomy Trains, 4th ed.（模型）
Neumann DA. Kinesiology of the Musculoskeletal System, 3rd ed.
JOSPT Clinical Practice Guidelines (shoulder/elbow).

items.title: Comparative Effects of Resistance Training and High-Intensity Interval Training on Body Composition, Metabolic Health, and Functional Strength in Overweight and Obese Adults: A 12-Week Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.principle: 在超重/肥胖成人中，12周抗阻训练与HIIT均可降低体脂和BMI，但抗阻训练在增加肌肉量、改善空腹血糖和握力方面优于HIIT。
items.mechanism: 抗阻训练通过机械负荷刺激肌肉蛋白合成与神经肌肉适应，增加肌肉量并提高握力；同时肌肉量增加可能改善胰岛素敏感性，从而降低空腹血糖。HIIT主要通过高心率间歇运动增加能量消耗和心肺刺激，改善体成分但肌肉合成刺激较弱。
items.evidence_note: 随机对照试验，90名超重/肥胖成人（BMI 31.0±4.3），分为抗阻组、HIIT组和对照组各30人，每周2次、共12周；采用3×2混合ANOVA和Bonferroni校正（p<0.017）。局限：摘要未报告饮食控制、依从性和具体效应量。
items.application: 对超重/肥胖人群，可能倾向将抗阻训练作为改善肌肉适能和血糖控制的优先选项；HIIT可作为改善体成分的替代或补充方案。
items.counterexample: 若训练依从性低、饮食未控制或训练强度不足70% 1RM，抗阻训练在肌肉量和血糖上的额外优势可能不成立。

items.title: "Train as You Play" or "Play as You Train"? Rethinking the Role of Match Data in Guiding Training Prescription.
items.principle: 仅依据比赛外部负荷指标复制比赛需求来制定训练处方，可能忽略情境依赖的个体差异和生理适应的非线性，导致训练不足或损伤风险增加。
items.mechanism: 比赛指标是战术决策、对手行为和心理学因素等复杂情境交互的结果；生理适应呈非线性，需结合外部负荷、内部反应、恢复标志和神经肌肉评估综合判断。
items.evidence_note: 邀请评论（invited commentary），非系统综述或原始研究；摘要信息不足，未提供样本或定量数据。
items.application: 训练处方可能倾向以解释性而非模仿性方式整合比赛数据，结合内部负荷和恢复指标进行个体化调整。
items.counterexample: 在比赛需求高度稳定且个体差异小的项目中，单纯复制比赛负荷可能仍有效，此时该原理的边界不成立。

items.title: Load Range During Isokinetic Knee Extension and Flexion Exercise in Strength-Matched Male and Female Collegiate Athletes.
items.principle: 在相对力量匹配的男女大学生运动员中，男性在等速膝伸屈运动中加速到设定角速度所需时间更短，且负荷范围更大，性别差异随角速度变化。
items.mechanism: 男性肢体加速能力更强，可能与其神经肌肉募集和肌纤维类型分布有关，使其更快达到预设角速度并维持90%以上预设速度的负荷范围。
items.evidence_note: 横断面研究，30名大学田径运动员（男15、女15），在60、120、180、300、350、400 deg·s-1下进行最大等速膝伸屈；重复测量ANOVA。局限：样本量小、仅田径运动员、摘要未报告具体效应量。
items.application: 等速测试解读时可能倾向按性别采用不同方案，避免因负荷范围差异误判力量；训练中可考虑性别特异性加速能力差异。
items.counterexample: 在非力量匹配人群或非运动员人群中，该性别差异可能不成立；低角速度下差异也可能减弱。

items.title: Longitudinal transcriptomic monitoring of erythropoietic adaptations in endurance athletes: a prospective study protocol.
items.principle: 耐力运动员外周血单核细胞的转录组会随训练负荷和低氧暴露呈现阶段依赖性变化，涉及低氧信号、红细胞分化、铁代谢和血管生成通路。
items.mechanism: 训练负荷和低氧暴露通过低氧诱导因子等信号通路调节红细胞生成相关基因表达，外周血单核细胞转录组可反映这些系统性分子适应。
items.evidence_note: 研究方案（protocol），计划纳入60名耐力运动员随访12个月；摘要信息不足，尚无结果数据。
items.application: 可能倾向将纵向转录组监测作为评估训练负荷和低氧暴露适应轨迹的辅助工具，而非单独诊断依据。
items.counterexample: 若采样时间、训练负荷量化误差大或个体变异高，转录组变化可能无法稳定反映红细胞生成适应。

items.title: Fatty infiltration of the lumbar paravertebral muscles is related to functional limitations in patients with adult spinal deformity.
items.principle: 成人脊柱畸形患者腰椎椎旁肌脂肪浸润程度越高（Goutallier 3-4级），矢状面失衡越重、步行速度越慢、步态偏差越大且生活质量越差。
items.mechanism: 椎旁肌脂肪浸润替代功能性肌纤维，削弱脊柱稳定和姿势控制能力，导致矢状面失衡（SVA增大、PI-LL不匹配）和步态功能下降。
items.evidence_note: 横断面研究，64名成人脊柱畸形患者，按Goutallier分级分为高浸润组（33人）和低-中浸润组（31人），使用全身双平面X线、3D步态分析和ODI问卷。局限：横断面设计无法确定因果，样本量中等。
items.application: 康复中可能倾向关注椎旁肌质量（减少脂肪浸润）以改善脊柱稳定和步行功能；Goutallier分级可作为常规MRI的简易评估工具。
items.counterexample: 若患者功能受限主要由神经压迫或关节病变而非肌肉质量导致，椎旁肌脂肪浸润与功能的关系可能不成立。

items.title: The Role of Physical Preparation in Motorsport Athletes Across Different Vehicle Types: A Narrative Review.
items.principle: 不同赛车类型的生理需求不同：封闭轮赛车手以持续热应激和肌肉耐力为主，开轮赛车手以高G力下的颈部和下肢力量为主，两轮车手以握力和有氧能力为主。
items.mechanism: 持续心血管负荷、神经肌肉负荷、持续G力和热应激因车辆类型而异，导致不同赛车类别对肌肉耐力、颈部和下肢力量、握力及热调节适应提出特异性要求。
items.evidence_note: 叙述性综述，纳入同行评议研究、实践报告、观点文章和网络材料；摘要信息不足，未提供系统检索或定量证据。
items.application: 可能倾向按赛车类别设计针对性体能训练，如封闭轮车手加强热适应和肌肉耐力，开轮车手加强颈部和下肢力量。
items.counterexample: 若车手个体体能基础差异大或车辆技术变化降低G力和热负荷，按类别统一训练方案可能不成立。

items.title: Exogenous Lactate Supplementation: A Promising Fueling Strategy to Enhance Endurance Performance.
items.principle: 外源性乳酸补充在生理相关剂量下可能作为氧化燃料与信号分子提升耐力表现，但现有采用低剂量单次给药的短期人体试验未显示表现获益。
items.mechanism: 乳酸穿梭范式：乳酸在糖酵解组织与氧化组织间进行底物交换，并参与系统能量代谢与细胞信号调节；外源乳酸可能补充氧化底物并影响代谢信号。
items.evidence_note: 叙述性综述/机制综述；未提供原始人体试验的样本量与具体数据；摘要信息不足，无法量化剂量-效应。
items.application: 可能倾向通过改进配方（安全递送生理相关剂量、非单次冲击式给药）来探索耐力项目的外源乳酸补充策略；目前不应据此推荐实际补充方案。
items.counterexample: 当剂量过低或采用单次冲击式给药时，人体试验未观察到耐力表现提升；高剂量给药的安全性与耐受性限制可能使该策略不成立。

items.title: Mental Fatigue Impairs Training Performance in Resistance-Trained Males and Females: A Velocity-Based Approach.
items.principle: 45分钟认知疲劳任务后，抗阻训练者在背蹲中的训练量（总次数）和首次重复向心速度均下降，且男性首次重复速度下降幅度大于女性。
items.mechanism: 认知疲劳可能降低中枢驱动与运动意图输出，表现为最大意图向心速度下降，并在多组训练中累积为训练量减少；具体外周机制摘要未阐明。
items.evidence_note: 随机交叉设计；19名有抗阻训练经验者（10男9女）；6次训练课，最后2次随机分为认知疲劳（45分钟AX-CPT）与对照（纪录片）；样本量小，摘要结尾被截断。
items.application: 在需要高速度意图的抗阻训练课之前，可能倾向避免或管理长时间高强度认知负荷，以免降低训练量与动作速度；可用速度监测识别认知疲劳影响。
items.counterexample: 在低强度、非最大意图或不受中枢驱动限制的训练任务中，该效应可能不明显；个体对认知疲劳的敏感性差异可能使结果不成立。

items.title: Heat Training Practices in Elite and World-Class Athletes: A Review of Preparation Strategies for Competition in Hot Outdoor Environments.
items.principle: 精英运动员在热环境比赛备战中常采用项目特异性热暴露（常与比赛环境相似或更严酷），并可在运动后被动加热；此类实践常伴随运动心率与核心温度下降、血浆容量增加等经典热适应标志。
items.mechanism: 热习服/热适应通过反复引起核心与皮肤温度、皮肤血流与出汗的持续升高，诱导心血管与体温调节适应（心率与核心温度降低、血浆容量增加）。
items.evidence_note: 综述纳入12项观察性研究（其中11项含项目特异性热暴露，5项含运动后被动加热）；热干预设计、课结构与热/心血管应变监测差异大，许多报告细节不足；摘要信息不足，无法判定实验室外有效性。
items.application: 可能倾向在热环境比赛前至少2周开始、每日60-90分钟、持续10-14天的热暴露，并结合项目特异性与运动后被动加热；需标准化记录以便评估效果。
items.counterexample: 当赛前减量、训练负荷或后勤限制导致方案无法实施或暴露强度不足时，热适应标志与表现获益可能不出现；观察性设计无法证明因果。

items.title: Beyond the Hangover: Associations Between Binge Drinking, Health, and Performance in Young Adult Resistance-Trained Females.
items.principle: 在年轻成年女性中，≥1年狂饮与较差的代谢健康（空腹及餐后血糖更高）相关，但在有抗阻训练者中未观察到骨密度、肌肉质量或体能表现的差异。
items.mechanism: 长期狂饮可能损害糖代谢（胰岛素敏感性），而抗阻训练可能维持肌肉质量与体能表现；具体机制摘要未阐明。
items.evidence_note: 横断面关联研究；四组各12人（久坐低饮酒、久坐狂饮、抗阻训练低饮酒、抗阻训练狂饮）；样本量小、观察性设计不能推断因果；摘要结论被截断。
items.application: 可能倾向在抗阻训练女性中关注饮酒模式对代谢健康的潜在不利关联，而非仅关注体能表现；营养与生活方式评估可纳入代谢健康监测。
items.counterexample: 在非抗阻训练或不同饮酒定义/时长人群中关联可能不同；横断面设计无法排除混杂，不能据此断定狂饮导致代谢差异。

items.title: Omega-3 Fatty Acid Supplementation Has Coronary and Other Selective Health Benefits: Comprehensive Results from the VITamin D and OmegA-3 TriaL (VITAL).
items.principle: 在未筛选心血管风险的一般人群中，每日1 g海洋n-3脂肪酸补充未显著降低主要心血管事件复合终点，但显著降低总心肌梗死、致死性心肌梗死、经皮冠状动脉介入与心衰再住院风险，并降低自身免疫病风险。
items.mechanism: n-3脂肪酸可能通过抗炎、抗血栓及心肌膜稳定性等途径选择性影响冠状动脉事件与心衰结局；具体机制摘要未展开。
items.evidence_note: 全国性随机、安慰剂对照、2×2析因试验；25,871名美国男性≥50岁与女性≥55岁，中位5.3年；主要终点未达显著，部分次要/辅助终点显著，存在多终点比较局限。
items.application: 可能倾向将每日1 g海洋n-3脂肪酸视为对特定冠脉事件与自身免疫病风险有选择性关联的补充策略；不应据此将其作为降低总心血管事件或总死亡率的普遍措施。
items.counterexample: 在主要心血管事件复合终点、总癌症发生率与全因死亡率上未观察到显著降低；效应在不同性别、鱼摄入量与心血管风险因素人群中存在异质性，不能一概而论。

items.title: Musical Feedback to Reduce the Knee Adduction Moment Via Center of Pressure Medialization: A Proof-of-Concept Study in Healthy Adults for Knee Osteoarthritis Gait Retraining.
items.principle: 在健康成人中，基于足底压力调制的实时音乐反馈可引导压力中心内侧化，从而显著降低膝关节内收力矩第二峰值（约13.7%）与膝内收角冲量（约9.4%），且不改变步速、足进展角与步宽。
items.mechanism: 压力中心内侧化主要通过踝内翻、踝外旋与髋内旋实现，改变地面反作用力相对于膝关节的力臂，从而降低膝内收力矩；同时可能伴随膝屈曲力矩峰值边缘性升高作为代偿。
items.evidence_note: 概念验证研究；12名健康成人（6女6男，31.5±5.3岁）；重复测量方差分析与统计参数映射；样本小、健康人群、短期训练，未在膝骨关节炎患者中验证。
items.application: 可能倾向将同步声音化生物反馈用于步态再训练以降低膝内收力矩，作为内侧膝骨关节炎的潜在辅助策略；需在患者人群中进一步评估。
items.counterexample: 当出现膝屈曲力矩峰值升高等等代偿模式时，单纯降低膝内收力矩的获益可能被抵消；在膝骨关节炎患者或不同步态模式人群中效果可能不成立。

items.title: Athletic Performance Adaptations: Just Training Sprints or Combining Sprints With Three Different Strength Training Methods?
items.principle: 在8周冲刺跑基础上加入高负荷最大力量训练（≥85% 1RM深蹲）比单纯冲刺跑或爆发力训练更能提升腿举最大等长收缩力、0-25米冲刺时间、跑步经济性和Wingate平均功率。
items.mechanism: 高负荷深蹲可能通过提高最大力量与动态发力率（RFD），进而改善短距离冲刺加速和骑行功率输出；摘要显示ΔMVIF与表现变化相关。
items.evidence_note: 探索性随机对照研究，58名休闲活动、非力量训练男女，8周3次/周，4组比较；摘要未报告盲法、效应量细节及女性亚组结果。
items.application: 可能倾向在冲刺训练中叠加高负荷最大力量训练以提升短距离冲刺和功率表现；肥大训练也可能改善部分冲刺指标。
items.counterexample: 对已有力量训练基础或高水平运动员不一定成立；爆发力训练组在多数指标上未优于对照，提示低负荷跳跃不能替代高负荷力量刺激。

items.title: Moderate-Intensity Interval Training Is Sufficient to Increase Muscle Mitochondrial Respiratory Capacity and Exercise Tolerance in Young Untrained Men.
items.principle: 7周中等强度间歇训练（4次/周、40分钟/次）可提高未训练年轻男性骨骼肌线粒体最大呼吸速率约50%、乳酸阈功率约43 W和肺V̇O2max约7%，且不损害血糖稳态。
items.mechanism: 训练增加线粒体质量和呼吸链复合体富集，从而提高氧化磷酸化能力；乳酸阈功率上升反映耐力表现改善。
items.evidence_note: 单组前后对照研究，11名健康未训练男性，7周MIIT；样本小、无对照组，摘要信息有限。
items.application: 可能倾向用中等强度间歇训练作为提升线粒体氧化能力和耐力阈值的低风险方案；对血糖稳态可能无不良影响。
items.counterexample: 对已训练人群或更高强度训练需求者，MIIT可能不足以继续提升；摘要未设对照，不能排除自然波动或重复测试效应。

items.title: Performance and Physiological Responses to Strength Training Programs in Elite Judo Athletes.
items.principle: 4周板块计划（BP）比波动计划（UP）更能提高精英柔道运动员下肢峰值功率，但伴随更高的自主神经扰动（HRVcv升高）。
items.mechanism: 板块计划集中训练刺激可能增强下肢功率适应，同时增加内部负荷和自主神经压力；两组CK和TNF-α随时间升高提示肌肉损伤和炎症反应。
items.evidence_note: 随机分组研究，18名精英柔道运动员（14男4女），4周、每周6次力量课；样本小、短期，摘要未报告具体效应量以外的混杂控制。
items.application: 可能倾向在短期备赛期采用板块力量计划提升下肢功率，但需监测HRV和主观状态以管理生理压力。
items.counterexample: 对上肢功率和CMJ无显著改变，说明板块计划并非全面优于波动计划；自主神经扰动较高可能不适合恢复不足者。

items.title: Biomechanical link between knee osteoarthritis and lumbar spine loading: An experimental and simulation-based analysis.
items.principle: 轻度至中度内侧膝骨关节炎患者步行时，模型预测的多裂肌、最长肌和髂肋肌力及L1-S1各水平腰椎压缩力高于健康对照，尽管组间近端运动学差异有限。
items.mechanism: 膝骨关节炎步态可能通过改变躯干肌肉激活模式，增加椎旁肌力和腰椎关节反作用力，从而增加腰椎负荷。
items.evidence_note: 探索性实验与模拟研究，8例膝骨关节炎患者和10名健康对照；样本很小，组间近端运动学差异有限，作者提示个体异质性可能被平均化掩盖。
items.application: 可能倾向在膝骨关节炎康复中评估躯干肌力和步态策略，以减少腰椎负荷；但不应据此直接推断因果关系。
items.counterexample: 若个体步态适应异质性强，组平均结果可能不适用于单个患者；摘要未证明膝骨关节炎导致腰椎负荷增加，仅为关联。

items.title: Ergocycling-Based Repeated-Sprint Training in Hypoxia Performed at Either 3,000 m or 2,000 m Similarly Impacts Overground Performance in Under-18 Field Hockey Players.
items.principle: 3周功率车重复冲刺训练在中等缺氧（3000 m）或低氧（2000 m）下均能降低U18曲棍球运动员陆上重复冲刺总时间，但两种缺氧程度间无显著差异。
items.mechanism: 缺氧重复冲刺可能通过增加无氧糖酵解和肌肉氧合应激，改善重复冲刺能力；但摘要未提供具体分子机制。
items.evidence_note: 非随机分组比较，15名高水平U18男子曲棍球运动员，3周6次功率车RSH；样本小，缺氧程度非随机分配，摘要信息有限。
items.application: 可能倾向用功率车重复冲刺训练改善陆上重复冲刺总时间；3000 m与2000 m缺氧暴露的额外收益可能相似。
items.counterexample: 陆上理论最大力和理论最大功率未改善，理论最大速度反而下降，提示功率车训练不能全面转化为陆上冲刺力-速特征。

items.title: Adaptive Responses to "Top-up" Repeated-Sprint Training in Hypoxia or Normoxia in Male University Basketball Players.
items.principle: 12次重复冲刺训练（先6次常氧，再6次缺氧或常氧补充）可提高男子大学篮球运动员6秒峰值功率、6秒平均功率、最大有氧功率和V̇O2peak，但第二阶段缺氧暴露未带来额外收益。
items.mechanism: 重复冲刺训练总量可能通过改善无氧功率和有氧能力产生适应；缺氧未额外增强适应，可能因训练量增加掩盖环境因素。
items.evidence_note: 非随机分组研究，15名男子大学篮球运动员，12次重复冲刺训练；样本小，第二阶段分组非随机，摘要信息有限。
items.application: 可能倾向用重复冲刺训练提升篮球运动员无氧功率和有氧能力；在已进行常氧冲刺训练后，追加缺氧暴露的额外价值可能有限。
items.counterexample: 重复冲刺能力（PPRSA）未改善，说明该训练方案对专项重复冲刺表现的迁移可能不足；缺氧“补充”未必优于常氧。

items.title: Cold fluid ingestion does not enhance exogenous carbohydrate oxidation during prolonged endurance exercise in the heat.
items.principle: 在热环境中进行长时间耐力骑行时，摄入4°C冷碳水化合物饮料相比约36°C温饮料，不改变外源性碳水化合物氧化速率（约0.50 vs 0.51 g/min）。
items.mechanism: 冷饮料降低心率和直肠温度（心血管与热应激），但未改变外源性葡萄糖氧化、总碳水/脂肪氧化及血糖、乳酸、胰岛素，提示降温效应未转化为肠道吸收或外源糖氧化增加。
items.evidence_note: 随机交叉试验，11名训练良好、非热习服男性自行车手，100分钟50% Wpeak骑行+计时赛，36°C环境，15%葡萄糖溶液60 g/h，[U-13C]葡萄糖示踪；样本小、单一性别、单一剂量。
items.application: 热环境中可能倾向用冷饮料改善热舒适和心血管应激，但不应期待其提高外源糖氧化或计时赛表现。
items.counterexample: 在更高热应激、脱水、不同糖浓度/多转运糖配方或热习服人群中，冷饮料对吸收或表现的影响可能不同；本摘要未支持表现获益。

items.title: The Effects of Intermittent Hypoxic Training Strategies on Maximal Oxygen Uptake in Healthy Humans: A Meta-analysis with Meta-regression.
items.principle: 间歇性低氧训练对健康人VO2max的效应依策略和人群而异：LHTL在运动员中显著提高VO2max，LLTH和PHC在非运动员中显著提高，而在另一人群中不显著。
items.mechanism: 低氧暴露的严重程度、持续时间与频率与VO2max变化显著相关，提示低氧剂量通过血液学/通气或外周适应影响有氧能力，但具体机制摘要未详述。
items.evidence_note: 系统综述与随机效应荟萃分析，62项对照研究、1332名参与者（610运动员/722非运动员），RoB2评估质量、漏斗图与Egger检验发表偏倚；异质性来源和具体方案细节摘要有限。
items.application: 可能根据人群选择策略：运动员倾向LHTL，非运动员可考虑LLTH或PHC；低氧剂量（严重度、时长、频率）可能是处方关键。
items.counterexample: 效应在运动员与非运动员间不一致，且PHC在运动员中无显著获益；不同低氧方案、训练背景和测量方法可能改变结论。

items.title: Effects of creatine supplementation on lean mass, muscle size and muscle performance during immobilisation and rehabilitation: A systematic review.
items.principle: 在1–2周肢体固定期间，肌酸补充对股四头肌横截面积减少无一致保护作用；在康复期联合抗阻训练时，部分研究报告肌酸组肌肉大小、瘦体重、力量和功率增幅更大。
items.mechanism: 肌酸可能通过磷酸肌酸能量缓冲和训练容量效应促进康复期抗阻训练适应；固定期BIA/DXA的瘦体重差异可能受水合作用影响而非真实肌肉保存。
items.evidence_note: 系统综述，6项随机安慰剂对照试验、n=118，年龄15–24岁，固定模型1–2周；结局指标包括CT/NMR、BIA/DXA，部分康复研究采用抗阻训练；样本小、人群年轻、固定期短。
items.application: 康复期可能倾向在抗阻训练基础上考虑肌酸以增强力量和肌肉量恢复；固定期单独使用肌酸不应被期待防止萎缩。
items.counterexample: 固定期肌肉横截面积研究未显示一致保护；BIA/DXA水合偏差可能夸大瘦体重获益；上肢与下肢表现结果不一致。

items.title: Pre-season friendly match-play as a double-edged sword: Performance gains and inflammatory cost in semi-professional soccer players (a natural experiment).
items.principle: 季前友谊赛累计出场时间越多，半职业足球运动员的体脂下降、下肢功率和通气阈速度提升越明显，同时炎症标志物（hs-CRP、IL-6、TNF-α）和肌损伤标志物升高越明显。
items.mechanism: 较大比赛负荷通过高代谢和机械刺激促进体成分与有氧/无氧表现适应，同时引起肌肉损伤和全身炎症反应；炎症标志物与比赛时间强相关（r=0.79–0.86）。
items.evidence_note: 自然实验，24名半职业男足球员，季前3个时间点评估，按8场友谊赛累计出场时间回顾分组（EP vs LP）；非随机分组、样本小、单队。
items.application: 季前可能倾向逐步增加比赛暴露以获取体成分和体能适应，同时监测炎症/肌损伤标志物以管理恢复。
items.counterexample: 炎症成本可能抵消表现获益或增加伤病风险；样本为单支半职业队，不能外推到精英或不同训练负荷结构。

items.title: Platelet Mitochondrial Bioenergetics in Adolescents at Risk of MASLD Following High-Intensity Interval Training.
items.principle: 在MASLD风险青少年中，4周监督下HIIT后血小板线粒体呼吸（NADH-linked和琥珀酸支持呼吸）仅在MASLD组下降，非MASLD组无此变化。
items.mechanism: 基线时MASLD组血小板最大电子传递能力、NADH-linked和琥珀酸支持呼吸更高，且与肝内甘油三酯和HOMA-IR正相关、与瘦素负相关；HIIT可能逆转与MASLD相关的线粒体生物能量学改变。
items.evidence_note: 非随机分组纵向研究，n=27（10 MASLD/17非MASLD），青少年15.4±1.5岁，4周监督HIIT，高分辨呼吸测定；样本小、分组非随机、血小板作为替代组织。
items.application: 可能倾向将HIIT作为改善肥胖青少年代谢风险相关线粒体功能的干预，但需结合肝脂和胰岛素抵抗评估。
items.counterexample: 血小板线粒体呼吸不能直接等同于骨骼肌或肝脏线粒体功能；无MASLD组无变化提示效应依赖基线代谢状态。

items.title: Influence of Guideline-Based Carbohydrate Intake on Training Adaptations, Health, and Sleep in Female Rugby Athletes: An Exploratory Study.
items.principle: 在7周季前中，将训练日碳水提高至约6.3 vs 3.1 g/kg/天可提高能量可用性（45.0 vs 29.9 kcal/kg FFM/天），但未显著改变力量、体能、体成分、生化指标或睡眠（除CON训练夜睡眠时长更长）。
items.mechanism: 提高碳水摄入增加训练日能量可用性，但摘要未显示其通过能量可用性改善训练适应或健康标志物；蛋白质摄入标准化（>1.2 g/kg/天）。
items.evidence_note: 探索性研究，半职业女子橄榄球运动员，干预n=7 vs CON n=6，7周季前，训练日全食物提供、非训练日随意；样本很小、非盲、探索性。
items.application: 可能倾向保证训练日碳水以维持能量可用性，但不应期待短期季前内显著增强力量或体成分适应。
items.counterexample: 样本小且探索性，可能不足以检测小效应；CON训练夜睡眠更长提示高碳水方案并非全面优于对照。

items.title: Comparison of the Linear versus Non-Linear Repeated Sprint Training on Lower Limb Sports Performance Tasks in Team Sport Athletes: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.principle: 在团队项目运动员中，非线性重复冲刺训练（NLRST）相比线性重复冲刺训练（LRST）对短距离冲刺时间（SST）和变向（COD）成绩的改善效应量更大，但主要结局的95%置信区间跨越零。
items.mechanism: NLRST通过包含变向、加减速等非直线冲刺模式，可能更贴近团队项目的多方向动作需求，从而对SST和COD产生更大的迁移效应；摘要未提供具体神经肌肉机制。
items.evidence_note: 系统综述与荟萃分析，纳入13项RCT、253名竞技团队项目运动员；SST的SMDC=0.479（95%CI -0.077至1.034），COD的SMDC=0.601（95%CI -0.131至1.332），置信区间均跨零；摘要未报告异质性、具体偏倚评估结果及次要结局的完整数据。
items.application: 在团队项目体能训练中，可能倾向采用含变向与多方向冲刺的NLRST以兼顾冲刺与变向能力，尤其对男性运动员、高训练量方案及≥12次课时的干预；但效应不确定，需个体化验证。
items.counterexample: 当主要目标是纯直线最大速度或训练条件限制无法安排变向时，NLRST的优势可能不成立；置信区间跨零意味着部分研究中LRST可能不劣于甚至优于NLRST。

items.title: Central and Peripheral Fatigue Following Free-Weight and Smith Machine Squat Training: Neuromuscular Efficiency in Knee Extensors.
items.principle: 在相同相对负荷（70% 1RM、4组×9次）下，自由重量深蹲比史密斯机深蹲引起更大的膝伸肌外周与中枢神经肌肉疲劳，而速度损失和主观疲劳感无差异。
items.mechanism: 自由重量深蹲需要更多稳定肌群参与和平衡控制，可能增加运动单位募集与中枢驱动需求，导致训练后抽动插值法测得的外周和中枢疲劳成分更大；摘要未提供具体生理通路。
items.evidence_note: 随机交叉设计，19名有训练经验的年轻男性（力量训练经验4.7±2.4年），比较自由重量与史密斯机深蹲；样本量小、仅男性、单次训练课，未评估长期适应。
items.application: 在力量训练处方中，若目标是同等力量/肥大适应下减少膝伸肌神经肌肉疲劳，可能倾向选择史密斯机深蹲；在需要高稳定肌参与或专项迁移时，自由重量仍可能更合适。
items.counterexample: 当训练目标包含平衡、核心稳定或自由重量专项迁移时，疲劳较小并不等于训练更优；该结论仅适用于70%1RM、4×9的深蹲方案和有训练经验男性。

items.title: Aerobic exercise preconditioning enhances skeletal muscle resistance and recovery after contusion: involvement of the SIRT1/PGC-1α axis.
items.principle: 在挫伤前进行有氧运动预适应可减轻小鼠腓肠肌损伤程度并改善伤后修复，该效应部分依赖SIRT1/PGC-1α信号轴及降低PGC-1α乙酰化。
items.mechanism: 有氧运动预适应持续激活SIRT1/PGC-1α信号、降低PGC-1α乙酰化，促进线粒体生物发生相关标志物和肌肉再生相关基因表达；SIRT1抑制剂EX527部分削弱该保护与修复效应。
items.evidence_note: 动物机制研究（小鼠腓肠肌挫伤模型），使用Western blot、免疫沉淀和qRT-PCR，并以EX527药理学抑制验证SIRT1参与；摘要未报告样本量、具体运动方案参数及组织学修复指标。
items.application: 在运动损伤预防与康复情境中，伤前规律有氧运动可能倾向增强骨骼肌抗损伤与修复能力；但此为动物证据，不能直接推及人类训练处方。
items.counterexample: 若损伤前缺乏有氧训练基础、或SIRT1通路被抑制/功能低下，预适应的保护效应可能减弱；该结论不能外推为人类临床康复方案。

items.title: The Effect of a Repetitive Feeding Challenge With Carbohydrate Versus Fat on Markers of Gastrointestinal Integrity and Systemic Outcomes in Response to Endurance Exercise.
items.principle: 在耐力运动中，为期7天的重复脂肪（20g坚果酱）与碳水化合物（47g凝胶）喂养挑战均不增加胃肠道损伤标志物（I-FABP）、细菌内毒素转位标志物（sCD14）或全身炎症（CRP）反应，且两组间无显著差异。
items.mechanism: 重复喂养挑战（gut training）可能提高肠道对脂肪或碳水化合物的耐受性，使运动应激下肠道屏障标志物反应不因补充剂类型而恶化；摘要未阐明具体屏障保护机制。
items.evidence_note: 随机对照喂养干预，36名耐力运动员（7女29男），先进行2小时60%VO2max跑加1小时自选距离测试的基线肠道挑战，再随机接受脂肪或CHO补充7天并复测；样本以男性为主，摘要未报告统计效能与盲法细节。
items.application: 在耐力运动营养中，赛前及赛中可能可考虑脂肪或碳水化合物密集食物作为肠道训练补充，而不必担心其加重肠道损伤标志物；但个体胃肠道症状仍需单独监测。
items.counterexample: 对于已有胃肠道疾病或对脂肪耐受差的运动员，该结论可能不成立；总胃肠道症状严重程度与I-FABP、sCD14、CRP无相关，说明标志物正常不代表无症状。

items.title: Joint-specific kinematic deviations in asymptomatic flatfoot using biplane fluoroscopy.
items.principle: 无症状扁平足者在提踵任务中维持更外翻的距下关节位置，并表现出踝关节（胫距）和胫腓/距腓关节矢状面活动度减小，而在步行中组间关节运动学无显著差异。
items.mechanism: 内侧足弓塌陷的形态学改变可能在负重提踵时限制胫距与腓骨关节的矢状面活动，并使距下关节偏向更外翻位置；步行时可能通过代偿维持接近正常的关节运动。
items.evidence_note: 横断面研究，23名参与者（13名对照、10名无症状扁平足），采用双平面透视和负重CT个体化骨模型，统计参数映射分析；样本小、仅无症状扁平足，无法确定因果关系或症状进展。
items.application: 在扁平足者的功能评估与训练中，可能倾向关注提踵等负重任务中的距下关节控制和踝背屈活动度，而非仅依据步行表现；但尚无证据支持特定干预可改变这些差异。
items.counterexample: 在步行任务中该差异不成立（组间无显著差异）；且无症状扁平足者不一定出现症状或功能障碍，运动学差异不能直接等同于病理。

items.title: An anatomically based functional upper cervical spinal unit tested under low quasi-static loading for use in an omnidirectional surrogate neck.
items.principle: 基于CT几何与棉质韧带替代物构建的上颈椎功能单元，在准静态屈伸、侧弯和轴向旋转下，其活动度与中立区均落在尸体文献值1个标准差内，并具有良好可重复性和生物仿真度。
items.mechanism: 以解剖标志定义韧带附着点并采用可调张力系统模拟韧带约束，使各关节在低准静态载荷下的运动学接近尸体标本；轴向旋转仿真度相对较低。
items.evidence_note: 体外生物力学模型开发与验证研究，基于1名31岁健康男性CT数据，与尸体标本数据比较ROM、NZ、可重复性和螺旋轴，采用CORA方法；单一个体几何、仅准静态低载荷、非在体研究。
items.application: 该模型可能用于碰撞安全测试中替代颈部假体的初步组件，提高多平面低载荷下的运动学仿真度；与运动训练或康复应用无直接关系。
items.counterexample: 在高速、动态或多平面复合加载下，该模型的生物仿真度尚未验证；轴向旋转的CORA仅0.44-0.65，提示该方向仿真度有限。

items.title: Effects of In-Season Contrast Strength Training on Jump Performance and Sprint Ability in Female Field Hockey Players.
items.principle: 6周赛季内对比力量训练（高负荷70-85%1RM + 低负荷约30%1RM高速爆发动作 + 高速专项任务）可提升亚精英女子曲棍球运动员的跳跃与短跑表现。
items.mechanism: 高负荷力量刺激后接低负荷高速爆发动作，可能通过增强牵张-缩短周期（SSC）的神经肌肉募集与发力速率，转化为跳跃和短跑能力。
items.evidence_note: 单队列前后测干预研究，25名亚精英女子曲棍球运动员，6周赛季内训练；无对照组，无法排除赛季常规训练或学习效应。
items.application: 赛季内可能采用对比训练组合（重负荷+轻负荷高速+专项高速任务）以兼顾力量与爆发力维持；跳跃提升幅度可能大于短跑。
items.counterexample: 无对照组时不能确定增益完全归因于对比训练；对已有高水平爆发力或训练量过高的运动员，叠加负荷可能增加疲劳而非增益。

items.title: Effects of Ballistic and Traditional Half-Squat Training With Light Loads on Strength, Jump, and Sprint Performance in Young Rugby Players: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.principle: 6周赛季内轻负荷（30-40%1RM）弹道跳跃蹲比传统半蹲更能提升年轻橄榄球运动员的最大力量与跳跃表现，但两者均未能阻止30米短跑表现下降。
items.mechanism: 弹道跳跃蹲具有完全加速和速度导向特性，可能更有效刺激发力速率与功率输出；但力量-功率增益不足以抵消密集赛程下短跑专项能力的下降。
items.evidence_note: 随机对照试验，25名高训练水平青年橄榄球运动员，每周3次共6周，3个时间点评估；样本量小，短跑下降原因（赛程疲劳）为推断。
items.application: 赛季内可能优先选用轻负荷弹道跳跃蹲以提升力量与跳跃并减少疲劳；同时可能需额外短跑专项训练以维持冲刺表现。
items.counterexample: 在赛程密集或短跑专项刺激不足时，仅靠力量-功率训练不能防止短跑下降；对短跑为主要目标的运动员单用此法可能不成立。

items.title: Lower-Body Strength and Hypertrophy Adaptations in Response to Concurrent Training in Trained Young Males.
items.principle: 11周同期训练（耐力+抗阻）在训练有素年轻男性中削弱最大等长力量增益，但不干扰跳跃相关爆发力与股外侧肌横截面积增长。
items.mechanism: 耐力训练可能干扰最大力量适应（MVIC仅在纯抗阻组增加），而爆发力（RFD、CMJ正冲量）与肌肥大可通过不同时间进程适应，未显示明显干扰。
items.evidence_note: 随机分组研究，30名训练有素年轻男性，分耐力、抗阻、同期训练三组，11周两中周期；样本量较小，结论限于下肢指标。
items.application: 若目标是最大力量，可能倾向避免同期大量耐力训练；若目标为爆发力或肌肥大，同期训练可能仍可接受，但爆发力适应可能延迟出现。
items.counterexample: 对以最大力量为优先目标的运动员，同期训练可能不成立；样本小且仅年轻男性，外推至女性或高水平力量运动员需谨慎。

items.title: Combined time-restricted feeding and resistance training enhance tirzepatide-induced improvements in adiposity and whole-body insulin sensitivity in female mice.
items.principle: 在肥胖雌性小鼠中，替尔泊肽联合限时进食与抗阻训练可加速减重、改善脂肪组织重塑并增强全身胰岛素敏感性，抗阻训练还提升力量表现。
items.mechanism: 替尔泊肽（GIP/GLP-1双激动剂）造成负能量平衡；限时进食与抗阻训练叠加进一步减少脂肪质量与脂肪细胞肥大，抗阻训练增加骨骼肌量并改善力量，可能协同改善胰岛素敏感性。
items.evidence_note: 动物实验（雌性Swiss小鼠，10周肥胖诱导后8周干预）；摘要信息不足，未提供具体效应量与统计细节，且物种差异限制外推。
items.application: 在动物模型中提示减重干预联合限时进食与抗阻训练可能更有利于体脂与胰岛素敏感性；人类应用仅为推测，需临床研究验证。
items.counterexample: 小鼠结果不能直接外推至人类；药物相关组合涉及医疗决策，不适用于无监督的营养或训练建议。
